# docker_service

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: resource. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

A Swarm service: a desired number of tasks (containers) of one image scheduled across the Swarm. Requires the provider to point at a Swarm manager. Almost every change is a rolling update in place (`ServiceUpdate`, governed by `update_config`); only `name` and changing `mode` (replicated, global, replicated_job, global_job) replace the service. Destroy removes the service and waits until its tasks are gone, so the networks, secrets and configs it used can be removed next. Add `converge_config {}` to make apply wait for the tasks to run.

### `networks`

nested attribute, map(object). Networks the tasks attach to (`TaskTemplate.Networks`), keyed by network name or ID (resolved to the ID, the attachment's `Target`); use `{}` as the value for a plain attachment. In a stack, the short name of a stack `network` block resolves to `<stack>_<name>`. Updated in place.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aliases` | `set(string)` | optional |  |  | Extra DNS names the service gets on this network (`Aliases`); the service name always resolves. |
| `driver_opts` | `map(string)` | optional |  |  | Driver options of this attachment (`DriverOpts`). |

nested attribute, list(object). Endpoint.Ports: the ports actually published, after the manager assigned any PublishedPort. Non-sensitive copy for handoff.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `Name`. |
| `protocol` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `Protocol`. |
| `publish_mode` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `PublishMode`. |
| `published_port` | `number` | computed |  |  | Upstream `PublishedPort`. |
| `target_port` | `number` | computed |  |  | Upstream `TargetPort`. |

### `configs`

list of blocks. Swarm configs mounted as files in the task containers (default path `/run/secrets/<file_name>` for secrets, `/<file_name>` for configs).

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `config_id` | `string` | required |  |  | ID or name of the config (resolved to its ID). In a stack, the short name of a stack `config` block resolves to `<stack>_<name>`. |
| `config_name` | `string` | optional |  |  | Name of the config; looked up from the ID when unset. |
| `file_name` | `string` | optional |  |  | File name (or absolute path) in the container. Defaults to the reference as written when it is a name, otherwise the config name. |
| `gid` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | File group GID (default `0`). |
| `mode` | `number` | optional, computed |  |  | File mode as a decimal number (default `292`, i.e. `0444`). |
| `runtime` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Reference the config as a runtime target instead of a file (`ConfigReference.Runtime`): it is not mounted, the runtime uses it, e.g. the config named in `privileges.credential_spec.config`. `file_name`, `uid`, `gid` and `mode` are then not sent. Needs Engine API >= 1.40. |
| `uid` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | File owner UID (default `0`). |

### `converge_config`

single block. When present, create and update wait until the service has converged: the wanted number of tasks running (every desired task for `global`) and no update paused or rolling back; for `replicated_job`, `total_completions` tasks completed; for `global_job`, every task of the current run finished with at least one completed. On timeout the apply fails with the task errors. Not sent to the daemon.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `delay` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | Poll interval (Go duration, default `5s`). |
| `timeout` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | Maximum wait (Go duration, default `3m`). |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `string` | optional |  |  | `default` (the daemon's profile) or `disabled` (`Mode`). |

### `privileges.credential_spec`

single block. Managed service account credential spec (`CredentialSpec`, Windows only); set one of `config`, `file` and `registry`.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `config` | `string` | optional |  |  | ID of a swarm config holding the credential spec (`Config`). |
| `file` | `string` | optional |  |  | Credential spec file name under the daemon's `CredentialSpecs` directory (`File`). |
| `registry` | `string` | optional |  |  | Registry value name holding the credential spec (`Registry`). |

### `privileges.seccomp`

single block. Seccomp filtering of the task containers (`Seccomp`). Needs Engine API >= 1.44.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `string` | optional |  |  | `default` (the daemon's profile), `unconfined` (no filtering) or `custom` (the JSON in `profile`) (`Mode`). |
| `profile` | `string` | optional |  |  | Seccomp profile JSON, used with `mode = "custom"` (`Profile`); e.g. `file("seccomp.json")`. |

### `privileges.selinux_context`

single block. SELinux labels of the task containers (`SELinuxContext`).

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `disable` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Disable SELinux labeling (`Disable`). |
| `level` | `string` | optional |  |  | SELinux level label (`Level`). |
| `role` | `string` | optional |  |  | SELinux role label (`Role`). |
| `type` | `string` | optional |  |  | SELinux type label (`Type`). |
| `user` | `string` | optional |  |  | SELinux user label (`User`). |

### `resources`

single block. CPU and memory limits and reservations per task.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `memory_swappiness` | `number` | optional |  |  | Memory swappiness of the task containers, 0 to 100 (`MemorySwappiness`); `-1` unsets a previous value. Unset: the OS default. Needs Engine API >= 1.52. |
| `swap_bytes` | `number` | optional |  |  | Swap per task in bytes, only together with `limits.memory_bytes` (`SwapBytes`); `-1` is unlimited swap. Unset: twice the memory limit. Needs Engine API >= 1.52. |

Nested blocks: `limits` (single block), `reservations` (single block).

### `resources.limits`

single block. Hard limits.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `memory_bytes` | `number` | optional |  |  | Memory in bytes. |
| `nano_cpus` | `number` | optional |  |  | CPU in units of 1e-9 CPUs (1000000000 = one CPU). |
| `pids` | `number` | optional |  |  | Maximum number of processes per task container (`Pids`); 0 or unset is unlimited. Needs Engine API >= 1.41. |

### `resources.reservations`

single block. Reservations the scheduler must find on a node.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `memory_bytes` | `number` | optional |  |  | Memory in bytes. |
| `nano_cpus` | `number` | optional |  |  | CPU in units of 1e-9 CPUs (1000000000 = one CPU). |

Nested blocks: `generic_resources` (list of blocks).

### `resources.reservations.generic_resources`

list of blocks. User-defined resources the node must advertise (`GenericResources`); each entry sets one of `named_resource_spec` and `discrete_resource_spec`.

Nested blocks: `discrete_resource_spec` (single block), `named_resource_spec` (single block).

### `resources.reservations.generic_resources.discrete_resource_spec`

single block. A countable resource (`DiscreteResourceSpec`).

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `string` | optional |  |  | Resource kind, e.g. `SSD` (`Kind`). |
| `value` | `number` | optional |  |  | Amount (`Value`). |

### `resources.reservations.generic_resources.named_resource_spec`

single block. A resource with a string value, e.g. a GPU UUID (`NamedResourceSpec`).

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `string` | optional |  |  | Resource kind, e.g. `GPU` (`Kind`). |
| `value` | `string` | optional |  |  | Resource value (`Value`). |

### `restart_policy`

single block. When Swarm restarts tasks that exit.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `condition` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | `none`, `on-failure` or `any` (default). |
| `delay` | `string` | optional |  |  | Delay between restart attempts (Go duration, e.g. `5s`). |
| `max_attempts` | `number` | optional |  |  | Maximum restarts before giving up; 0 or unset means unlimited. |
| `window` | `string` | optional |  |  | Window used to evaluate the restart policy (Go duration). |

### `rollback_config`

single block. How a failed update rolls back.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `delay` | `string` | optional |  |  | Delay between batches (Go duration). |
| `failure_action` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | `pause` (default), `continue` or `rollback`. |
| `max_failure_ratio` | `number` | optional |  |  | Fraction of tasks that may fail before `failure_action` triggers (0 to 1). |
| `monitor` | `string` | optional |  |  | Time to watch each task for failure after it starts (Go duration). |
| `order` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | `stop-first` (default) or `start-first`. |
| `parallelism` | `number` | optional, computed |  |  | Tasks updated at once (default 1; 0 means all at once). |

### `secrets`

list of blocks. Swarm secrets mounted as files in the task containers (default path `/run/secrets/<file_name>` for secrets, `/<file_name>` for configs).

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file_name` | `string` | optional |  |  | File name (or absolute path) in the container. Defaults to the reference as written when it is a name, otherwise the secret name. |
| `gid` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | File group GID (default `0`). |
| `mode` | `number` | optional, computed |  |  | File mode as a decimal number (default `292`, i.e. `0444`). |
| `secret_id` | `string` | required |  |  | ID or name of the secret (resolved to its ID). In a stack, the short name of a stack `secret` block resolves to `<stack>_<name>`. |
| `secret_name` | `string` | optional |  |  | Name of the secret; looked up from the ID when unset. |
| `uid` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | File owner UID (default `0`). |

### `ulimits`

list of blocks. Resource ulimits of the task containers. Updated in place.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hard` | `number` | required |  |  | Hard limit. |
| `name` | `string` | required |  |  | Ulimit name, e.g. `nofile`. |
| `soft` | `number` | required |  |  | Soft limit. |

### `update_config`

single block. How a changed service rolls out to its tasks.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `delay` | `string` | optional |  |  | Delay between batches (Go duration). |
| `failure_action` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | `pause` (default), `continue` or `rollback`. |
| `max_failure_ratio` | `number` | optional |  |  | Fraction of tasks that may fail before `failure_action` triggers (0 to 1). |
| `monitor` | `string` | optional |  |  | Time to watch each task for failure after it starts (Go duration). |
| `order` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | `stop-first` (default) or `start-first`. |
| `parallelism` | `number` | optional, computed |  |  | Tasks updated at once (default 1; 0 means all at once). |

## Example

```terraform
resource "docker_secret" "db_password" {
  name = "db_password"
  data = base64encode("change-me")
}

resource "docker_config" "nginx" {
  name = "nginx-default.conf"
  data = base64encode("server { listen 80; location / { return 200 \"ok\n\"; } }")
}

resource "docker_service" "web" {
  name     = "web"
  image    = "nginx:1.27-alpine"
  replicas = 3

  # Overlay networks keyed by name or ID; `{}` attaches without extras.
  networks = {
    frontend = { aliases = ["www"] }
    backend  = {}
  }

  env = {
    TZ = "UTC"
  }

  # Task container settings; all of these update in place (rolling update).
  hostname          = "web-{{.Task.Slot}}"
  hosts             = ["db.internal:10.0.0.5"]
  cap_drop          = ["NET_RAW"]
  sysctls           = { "net.core.somaxconn" = "1024" }
  stop_grace_period = "30s"
  stop_signal       = "SIGQUIT"
  init              = true

  dns_config {
    nameservers = ["10.0.0.2"]
    options     = ["ndots:2"]
  }

  ulimits {
    name = "nofile"
    soft = 65536
    hard = 65536
  }

  # Bump to force a rolling restart without other changes.
  force_update = 1

  labels = {
    app = "shop"
  }

  mounts {
    type   = "volume"
    source = "web-cache"
    target = "/var/cache/nginx"

    volume_options {
      no_copy = true
      driver_config {
        name = "local"
      }
    }
  }

  mounts {
    type   = "tmpfs"
    target = "/tmp"

    tmpfs_options {
      size_bytes = 67108864
      mode       = 448 # 0700
    }
  }

  endpoint_spec {
    ports {
      name           = "http"
      target_port    = 80
      published_port = 8080
    }
  }

  secrets {
    secret_id = docker_secret.db_password.id
    file_name = "db_password"
  }

  configs {
    config_id = docker_config.nginx.id
    file_name = "/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf"
  }

  update_config {
    parallelism    = 1
    delay          = "10s"
    failure_action = "rollback"
    order          = "start-first"
  }

  restart_policy {
    condition    = "on-failure"
    max_attempts = 3
  }

  placement {
    constraints = ["node.role==worker"]
    preferences = ["spread=node.labels.zone"]
  }

  resources {
    limits {
      nano_cpus    = 500000000
      memory_bytes = 268435456
      pids         = 256
    }
  }

  # Hardening: no privilege escalation through setuid binaries.
  privileges {
    no_new_privileges = true
  }

  # 127.0.0.1, not localhost: busybox wget tries ::1 first, and the mounted
  # default.conf listens on IPv4 only, so a localhost check never passes.
  healthcheck {
    test           = ["CMD", "wget", "-q", "-O-", "http://127.0.0.1/"]
    interval       = "30s"
    timeout        = "5s"
    retries        = 3
    start_period   = "1m"
    start_interval = "5s" # check more often while starting
  }

  logging {
    driver = "json-file"
    options = {
      max-size = "10m"
    }
  }

  # Wait for all replicas to run before apply finishes.
  converge_config {
    timeout = "3m"
    delay   = "5s"
  }
}

# A one-off job: runs 6 tasks to completion, 2 at a time. With
# converge_config, apply waits until total_completions tasks completed.
# Changing mode (e.g. to "replicated") replaces the service.
resource "docker_service" "migrate" {
  name              = "db-migrate"
  image             = "busybox:1.36"
  args              = ["sh", "-c", "echo migrating; sleep 5"]
  mode              = "replicated_job"
  max_concurrent    = 2
  total_completions = 6

  restart_policy {
    condition = "on-failure"
  }

  converge_config {
    timeout = "5m"
  }
}
```

## Import

```shell
# Import by service name or ID. Network references come back as IDs and the
# image with its digest pin until the configuration is applied once.
terraform import docker_service.web web
```
